$body = @{
    gender="Male"
    age = 67
    hypertension = 0
    heart_disease = 1
    ever_married = "Yes"
    residence_type = "Urban"
    work_type = "Private"
    avg_glucose_level = 228.69
    bmi = 36.6
    smoking_status = "formerly smoked"
    model_choice = "Baseline"
} | ConvertTo-Json

Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:8000/predict" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType "application/json"
